newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: TENNIS-INJURED PIERCE PULLS OUT OF HEINEKEN TROPHY.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-INJURED PIERCE PULLS OUT OF HEINEKEN TROPHY.

text.p: French second seed Mary Pierce withdrew from the Heineken Trophy grass court tournament on Thursday because of an injured right elbow.
Pierce, seeded ninth for Wimbledon, was due to play her quarter-final match against eighth seed Asa Carlsson on Sweden.
Wimbledon champion Richard Krajicek, seeded three, is scheduled to play German Hendrik Dreekmann but has already indicated he is unlikely to stay for Sunday's final.
The Dutchman said he would play a couple of rounds here, but playing the final would be tricky with his Wimbledon title defence due to begin on Monday.
